---
# Beacon Point EMA - Post-Deployment Experience Survey
# This project contains synthetic data and analysis created for demonstration
# purposes only.
#
# This file is plain Markdown plus R code chunks, the same as an .Rmd file.
# Each `--- page_id` line starts a new survey page and each sd_question()
# call adds a question. You do not need to know Quarto to edit it; surveydown
# uses Quarto behind the scenes to turn this file into a web page.

theme-settings:
  theme: default
  barposition: top
  footer-left: "Beacon Point EMA (fictional) | Built with open-source [surveydown](https://surveydown.org)"

survey-settings:
  # "local" saves each response to local_data.csv in this folder.
  # Change to "database" after running sd_db_config() to save to Postgres.
  mode: local
  show-previous: true
  use-cookies: false
  highlight-unanswered: true
  capture-metadata: false
  required:
    - region
    - role
    - score_overall

system-messages:
  next: Next
  previous: Back
  exit: Submit survey
---

```{r}
library(surveydown)

# Five-point scale reused for every rating question
rating_scale <- c(
  "1 - Very poor" = "1",
  "2 - Poor" = "2",
  "3 - Acceptable" = "3",
  "4 - Good" = "4",
  "5 - Excellent" = "5"
)
```

--- welcome

# Post-Deployment Experience Survey

Thank you for your service on this deployment. This short survey (about 3
minutes) helps the Continuous Improvement Office find what to fix before the
next activation. Responses are reviewed in aggregate.

> This project contains synthetic data and analysis created for demonstration
> purposes only. Beacon Point Emergency Management Agency is fictional.

--- about_you

## Your deployment

```{r}
sd_question(
  type = "select",
  id = "region",
  label = "Which region were you deployed to?",
  option = c(
    "Northern Coast" = "northern_coast",
    "Eastern Seaboard" = "eastern_seaboard",
    "Gulf Coast" = "gulf_coast",
    "Central Plains" = "central_plains",
    "Mountain West" = "mountain_west",
    "Pacific Rim" = "pacific_rim"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type = "select",
  id = "incident_type",
  label = "What type of incident was it?",
  option = c(
    "Hurricane" = "hurricane",
    "Flood" = "flood",
    "Wildfire" = "wildfire",
    "Tornado" = "tornado",
    "Severe Storm" = "severe_storm",
    "Winter Storm" = "winter_storm"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type = "mc",
  id = "role",
  label = "What was your primary role?",
  option = c(
    "Field Staff" = "field_staff",
    "Supervisor" = "supervisor",
    "Reservist" = "reservist",
    "Logistics Specialist" = "logistics_specialist",
    "Liaison Officer" = "liaison_officer"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type = "mc_buttons",
  id = "first_deployment",
  label = "Was this your first deployment?",
  option = c("Yes" = "yes", "No" = "no")
)

sd_question(
  type = "numeric",
  id = "deployment_weeks",
  label = "About how many weeks were you deployed?"
)
```

--- ratings

## Rate your experience

```{r}
sd_question(
  type = "mc_buttons",
  id = "score_onboarding",
  label = "Onboarding and just-in-time training",
  option = rating_scale
)

sd_question(
  type = "mc_buttons",
  id = "score_tools_tech",
  label = "Tools and technology (laptops, tablets, connectivity)",
  option = rating_scale
)

sd_question(
  type = "mc_buttons",
  id = "score_communication",
  label = "Communication and briefings",
  option = rating_scale
)

sd_question(
  type = "mc_buttons",
  id = "score_logistics",
  label = "Lodging, vehicles and logistics",
  option = rating_scale
)

sd_question(
  type = "mc_buttons",
  id = "score_leadership",
  label = "Leadership and supervisor support",
  option = rating_scale
)

sd_question(
  type = "mc_buttons",
  id = "score_overall",
  label = "Overall deployment experience",
  option = rating_scale
)
```

--- wrap_up

## Final thoughts

```{r}
sd_question(
  type = "mc_buttons",
  id = "would_redeploy",
  label = "Would you volunteer to deploy again?",
  option = c("Yes" = "yes", "Unsure" = "unsure", "No" = "no")
)

sd_question(
  type = "textarea",
  id = "comment",
  label = "What is one thing we should keep doing or change before the next deployment?"
)
```

--- end

## Thank you

Your response has been recorded. The Continuous Improvement Office reviews
results weekly and shares what changed as a result.

```{r}
sd_close("Submit survey")
```
